decisions.decision: Build T-158 now as a local page served by the Task Command Center (workshop-plan/tasks), e.g. /pipeline. Match the layout of the reference desk in coord/private-refs.md, but never name the client and never put it on the public mirror. Make all 6 bands: feedback by source/brand, bugs by severity and age, features by decision, 24h ship rate and PR-to-live time, dogfooding experiments, customer tier mix. Every KPI card gets a live/derived tag, a plain-English caption, and a note saying exactly what the number counts. Wire each band to whatever source exists today: tasks.json, git/PR history from the product repos, and the T-151 intake once it lands. Where no source exists yet, the band shows 'no data yet, fed by T-15x' rather than placeholder numbers. Add a weekly review job: a launchd Monday snapshot plus a log note. Then move the task to review for Ben and Bharath.
